confidence_notes: Medium overall. Beer, coffee and restaurant anchors triangulate search-surfaced Arica aggregator and menu figures with 2026 Chile-wide estimates; CLP figures were converted to USD at mid-2026 rates implied by the sources. Sources vary widely, and some Arica menus are undated or more than a year old. Cocktail and wine are weaker: cocktail is set from mostly undated Arica bar and cafe menus and cross-checked against draft beer at roughly 2.6 times; wine is set from one Arica cafe glass price, a 2024 winery-cafe price and rough parity with draft beer. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no accommodation search was run and no current listings were checked. The FX value is the latest RBA rate surfaced by search (18 Nov 2026); the 19 Nov rate was not confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: No database comparable was used. Arica is treated as a northern Chilean coastal city priced modestly below Santiago, per Arica-versus-Santiago comparison pages in the search results. Food and drink anchors use Arica-specific menus and listings where available and Chile-wide 2026 estimates otherwise. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a mid-sized Chilean tourism city in July, outside the December-February beach peak.
